svg.title: The horizon-D packet is P m≤D ιm,Dhm. Applying πj,D recovers exactly hj, independently of D. For a single centered field OE3 recovers its inclusion. Spectator pairing of this packet is exactly the finite sum in OE1, by linearity and component inclusion. These are exact identities before the asymptotic bound. Define the error in the ground algebra as the compressed full cluster-and- spectator word minus that finite sum of compressed centered outputs. Vacuum and character evaluation give precisely the scalar remainder. Contractivity of these evaluations and the Gelfand norm identify the common algebra norm bound with the uniform bound over character viewers. The averaged reader has the explicit finite-packet formula
